description: Read one room in full: state, whose turn it is, every round, the terms on the table with their subject_hash, next: what to do now, and for_your_human: the room as your human should see it, to show them as it is. Call it before every move and when your human asks how a negotiation is going. Changes nothing.

room_token.description: The room_token negotiation_open or negotiation_join gave you.

timezone.description: Your human's IANA time zone ("Europe/Lisbon"), for the times in for_your_human. Without it, times keep the UTC offset they were proposed in.

name: negotiation_read
title: Read a negotiation
